professionalSummary: Data Scientist with experience building and maintaining item-level demand forecasting models using LightGBM in Python, managing feature pipelines in dbt, conducting recurring forecast accuracy reviews, and documenting models for governance.
experienceHighlights: Built a LightGBM model forecasting next‑day demand for 140 menu items across 62 restaurants, incorporating holiday, weather, and local‑event features.
Maintained the dbt project feeding the model, adding freshness and not‑null tests on point‑of‑sale and delivery‑app tables.
Ran the weekly forecast review with commissary planners, logging manual overrides for items exceeding forecast error tolerance.
Wrote a model card detailing inputs, limitations, and monthly retraining schedule, presented to the data governance group in November 2023.
Tracked weighted mean absolute percentage error on a rolling eight‑week holdout and published results on the planners' dashboard each Monday.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Two‑page summary memo for regional directors outlining model features, forecast vs. actual sales for one restaurant over one week, and a statement that the model has reduced food waste by roughly a fifth across the estate (no waste‑log figures provided).
skills: Python (LightGBM), SQL, dbt, feature pipeline testing, forecast accuracy review, model documentation, dashboard publishing
